details:
Description

When switching between worlds, the client intermittently deadlocks. The "leave room" operation times out, the Photon peer is left in state ConnectingToMasterServer, and every subsequent rejoin attempt then fails. The client never recovers on its own - only killing the VRChat process and relaunching fixes it.

Packet capture (Windows pktmon, all traffic) shows the client stops transmitting entirely right after the transition begins, while the game server keeps sending keep-alives to it for another 25+ seconds. The server still believes the player is in the room, but the client sends zero packets.

The client also never logs "Connecting to realtime network" again after the first failure, and the retry interval decays from 30 seconds down to about 5 seconds as it keeps failing (observed 16 consecutive retries over 4 minutes).

This is not tied to time spent in an instance, player count, destination world size, or whether the switch crosses regions: in one session 12 consecutive world switches succeeded (solo, multiplayer, cross-region, and a 1163 MB world download) and then the 13th failed. The same build and machine can go an entire evening without it.

Reproduction Steps

STEPS TO REPRODUCE

1. Launch VRChat and join any world instance (region Japan).

2. Stay a few minutes - solo or with other players, both reproduce.

3. Open the menu and join another world / create a new instance.

4. Observe the transition.

There is no reliable trigger. The same action succeeds dozens of times and then fails once. Reproducing it requires normal play over an extended session; it cannot be forced. Approximate rate: 1-2 times per play session.

WHAT HAPPENS

1. Transition starts, loading screen appears.

2. About 16 seconds later: "Exception on room leave (but left anyway), moving on: <Photon type>: Operation timed out".

3. Immediately after: "Switching to network region jp (current state: ConnectingToMasterServer)".

4. About 30 seconds later: "Failed to connect to region, status was: ConnectingToMasterServer" followed by "Resetting game flow because Failed to connect to network region".

5. The client retries the same destination indefinitely; each retry fails and the interval shortens.

TEMPORARY WORKAROUND

- Kill the VRChat process completely (Task Manager -> end VRChat.exe) and relaunch. This is the only thing that works; after restart the client connects normally.

- Waiting does not help: the client retried 16 times over 4 minutes and never recovered.

- Changing the region or rejoining from the menu does not help once it has happened.

- Nothing else tried has any effect (see environment notes below).

ENVIRONMENT NOTES / ALREADY RULED OUT

VRChat Build : 2026.4.1p3-1939-4803d92ede-Release

Unity        : 6000.0.67f1-DWR

Store        : Steam (standalonewindows, desktop mode, --no-vr)

OS           : Windows 11 10.0.26200

CPU / GPU    : AMD Ryzen 7 9700X / NVIDIA RTX 5070 12GB

RAM          : 32 GB

Ruled out with no effect: NVIDIA driver reinstall, NIC power-saving options, disabling IPv6, antivirus exclusions, clearing the asset-bundle cache, changing VRChat region, running with and without a game accelerator, solo vs. populated instances.
